concerns.text: The spec still assumes "'Permeability of gases in MOFs' dataset on Figshare (or the NIST/ICSD fallback) contains at least 50 unique gas-MOF pairs" as the target-variable source, but the upstream research phase recorded NO verified source for experimental permeability labels. The idea itself hedged ("verify dataset availability"), yet the spec hard-codes the assumption with only a fail-fast (<50 pairs) guard and no fallback path or reframing. The research question (predicting experimental permeability) is unanswerable as specified unless this gap is resolved at the spec level (verified dataset, defined fallback, or explicit scope reframe).

Under-reach vs the idea's methodology: the idea specifies three baselines — "(i) linear regression on handcrafted descriptors, (ii) standard GCN on the combined graph, (iii) separate GCNs for molecule and framework with late fusion." FR-005 and US-2 include only the first two; the separate-GCN late-fusion baseline, which is the most direct test of "joint vs separate encoding," is dropped. Add it or justify its removal.

Cross-validation fold count is inconsistent with the idea and internally vague: the idea specifies 3-fold CV ("reduced from 5-fold to save time"), while FR-009 says "stratified k-fold", SC-006 says "5 cross-validation folds", and the Assumptions say "Stratified 5-fold". Pick one fold count and state it consistently.
FR-004 omits the weight decay (1e-5) specified in the idea's training protocol. Minor fidelity gap; either include it or note the deviation.
